observed_behavior: Nested Node test commands exited zero but omitted the integration test; output reported recursive node:test execution and skipped files.
expected_behavior: The configured fixture full-QA profile executes its actual unit and integration files and records their passing output.
causal_mechanism: The subprocess inherited NODE_TEST_CONTEXT from the outer test harness, so Node classified its test command as recursive execution.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Letting test-runner control metadata leak into an independently executed acceptance fixture subprocess.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: The child can return a successful exit status without executing the intended files.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Fixture subprocesses execute the real program path with test-runner control metadata removed at the harness boundary.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: The fixture declares env -u NODE_TEST_CONTEXT before its Node unit/integration commands and asserts the actual test-name output. Production QA continues to execute the configured argv profile without test-only branches.

applicability_conditions: An integration test runs a Node test command as a subprocess.
confirmation_evidence: The failed output assertion captured the recursive node:test warning despite exit zero.
The corrected profile executes the named combined mainline/campaign integration test and the real database fixture unit test.
regression_proofs: tests/rolling-publication.integration.test.ts: mainline candidate preserves published campaign history and requires complete full QA on its exact merged tree
tests/rolling-campaign-store.integration.test.ts: publication batch freezes one shared partial claim across concurrent requests and restart
